# [[Hemlock, The Toxic]]
![351](data:image/png;base64,)
What is known of Hemlock is that used to be a normal merc that came to paradise city seeking his fortune; it was said that he rose up the rank quickly so much that Harmony offered him a seat at the table.  Hemlock rules the street gangs and is the kingpin of drugs and violence within the city walls. He keeps other gangs in check. They say he is the strongest of the five heads at least in terms of physical might. Many an inspiring Mercs have attempted to take his throne over the years and none have EVER gotten close.
# [[The Duke, The Iron Fisted]]
![278](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
The Duke is the face of Paradise city military might. There are rumors he also controls the police but no one has ever proven that. He is known for suppressing riots, instilling fear and creating some most dangerous arcanum weapons that hit the streets of Paradise city. He always wears a mask and no one knows what he really looks like under it.
# [[The Big Boss]]
![282](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
The mysterious leader of the corporations of Paradise city. He is the ruler of the city’s money. He helps guide and some say control all of the corporations that have city walls. The life of corpo as they call it is cut throat. Much like Hemlock, many have tried to overthrow the big boss only to be blindsided at the last minute and have everything taken from them. The world of business is a cold place. Money and power are only things that grease its wheels. 
# [[Professor Lovelace]]
![311](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
The Leader of Paradise City R&D. The head scientific mind behind all of paradise cities arcanum projects. If it is related to science in any way she has had a hand in it. Some say she has gone too far doing twisted experiments on those unlucky enough to cross her path. Even so she is also one of few people in the world to have made deep discoveries with magic tech pushing the world forward.
# [[Madam Sonya]]
![306](data:image/jpeg;base64,)
The Madam is a woman of high renown within the city walls. She is interlocked with fashion, high art and the media of the city. She controls the new outlets and people have risen and fallen based on what she puts on the screen. Some say she is the culture of the city itself. She said to one of the most cutthroat of five heads beside the Big Boss.
